name: Raika Grace
source:
Raika has just opened her own private investigation firm. Seela is her administrative assistant. She loves her new job but business is slow. She thinks it may have been a mistake to leave the police department but Seela convinces her a little advertising may be the spark they need. Her former coworker Lilia manages to break the spell of boredom with a case of unexplained abductions occurring throughout the city. Following Seela's abduction and Lilia's rape, Raika takes over the case as her own.

Raika was born under the sign of Taurus (April 20 - May 20.)
